headline: Indian Motorcycle Aims to Grow Up to 30% in Mexico in 2027 After Halving Its Lineup
summary: After becoming independent of Polaris, the US motorcycle brand plans to expand its Mexican dealers from 12 to 15. Mexico accounts for 50% of its Latin American sales.
why: Indian Motorcycle is a US premium motorcycle maker that was previously part of Polaris. Its regional expansion shapes the sales outlook for the business in Latin America.
original_headline: Indian Motorcycle busca crecer hasta 30% en México en 2027 tras reducir a la mitad su catálogo
